answer: A reputation escrow with slashing stops sybils by making fraud forfeit collateral. Each agent deposits 50 tokens, locked 30 days, for one vertex tied to a hardware key. Three attestations over 14 days release 10 tokens, while a proven fable — a fabricated claim — slashes all 50 tokens. A challenger staking 5 tokens opens a dispute decided by 7 reviewers in 72 hours, so shale-thin histories fail review. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 tokens and 1,000 keys; at $2 each, $100,000 lost to one slash each. Like a quarry keeping only load-bearing stone, it keeps only surviving deposits.
